definition.name: nonvanishing-delta-projection
definition.definition: Byte-matched from refs/kitaev-2405.02434/approximate_algebras.tex (tex:918-930): P^\dag=P, ||P^2-P|| <= \delta; hence ||P|| <= O(\delta) or | ||P||-1 | <= O(\delta+\eps); nonvanishing = second alternative; nontrivial = P and I-P both nonvanishing.
